title: Beef Stroganoff
description: An easy weeknight meal to make at home.
steps: Cook the ground beef in a pan until browned.
Add chopped onion and cook until onions sweat down.
Stir in garlic and Dijon mustard.
Add beef broth and bring to a light boil.
Add noodles and cook until soft, ensuring they are halfway submerged in broth.
Stir in sour cream and cream cheese until well incorporated and thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with chopped green onion on top.

healthy: Ground beef gives plenty of protein.
Onion and garlic add a little vegetable.
not_healthy: Heavy cream, sour cream and cream cheese make it very high in saturated fat.
Usually served over noodles or rice, adding refined carbs.
